title: 跨節點累計、Shadow/Enforce 模式切換、月初重置與臨時覆寫 (Cross-Node Fair-Use, Shadow/Enforce, Monthly Reset & Temporary Override)
expected: Fair-Use policy enforces tier invariants (tier[0]=0, strictly increasing thresholds, non-increasing rates, non-decreasing priority, >= minimum_rate), aggregates member usage across exits, transitions from shadow to enforce mode, supports audited temporary member overrides with expiry, and resets to Tier 0 at the next UTC calendar month.
actual: Live control-plane API verified fair_use semantic validation (422), shadow->enforce revision creation with temporary member override (01a18a56-4541-7373-a027-bf69365683ea), idempotent replay, and 428/412/202 activation, while central PostgreSQL mechanisms verified cross-node usage aggregation, per-exit directional effective rates, override expiry, and 00:00:00Z monthly reset. Live multi-node data-plane traffic is blocked because the devstack runs 1 node container (fvpn-w4-usage-node), node publication returns HTTP 422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE, and device_bindings=0.
blockers: End-to-end multi-node member traffic shaping on the live compose stack is blocked because the devstack runs 1 node container (fvpn-w4-usage-node), PUT /api/v1/admin/nodes/01a18a49-4020-71c6-ad22-893acd249a8b/publication returns HTTP 422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE, and device_bindings count=0.

commands.output: HTTP 422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE: {"error":{"code":"NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE","message":"node does not satisfy serving baseline requirements","request_id":"01a18a56-1b83-7802-8c0f-98bbc9d92e63","retryable":false,"details":{"failed_checks":["provisioning_state=applying (want ready)"]}}}

POST /api/v1/admin/policies (fair_use negative 422s, enforce + override 201, idempotent replay) & POST /activate (428/412/202)
commands.output: neg_422=[422,422,422] create=201 rev=2 replay_match=true missing_if_match=428 stale_if_match=412 activate=202

mechanism_checks.name: LiveFairUsePolicyValidationShadowToEnforceOverrideAndConcurrencyGuards
mechanism_checks.summary: Live POST /api/v1/admin/policies rejected invalid fair_use tiers with 422, created revision 2 (mode=enforce with memberA override, id=01a18a56-4541-7373-a027-bf69365683ea), replayed identically under same Idempotency-Key, enforced 428/412 If-Match preconditions, and activated with 202.

mechanism_checks.name: CrossNodeUsageAggregationAndPerExitRateScope
mechanism_checks.summary: Usage from Exit Node 1 (60 GB) and Exit Node 2 (55 GB) merges into one 115 GB period total crossing Tier 1 (100 GB); each exit computes its own directional rate_scope effective rate (Node 1: 25 Mbps, Node 2: 15 Mbps).

mechanism_checks.name: ShadowModeVsEnforceModeAndNodeAckSummary
mechanism_checks.summary: Shadow mode records would_apply_tier_index=1 with generation=0 and unthrottled node rates; switching to enforce mode increments generation=1 and applies Tier 1.

mechanism_checks.name: AdminOverrideExpiryAndNewMonthPeriodReset
mechanism_checks.summary: SetOverride elevates member to 100 Mbps (state=override, gen=2) until valid_until, automatically restores Tier 1 (25 Mbps, gen=3) on expiry, and resets to Tier 0 (state=normal, gen=4) at 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.
